description: Light aircraft of the Weimar years. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

Junkers A 50 Junior record-flight sport aircraft. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

The world's first all-metal airliner, a 1919 Junkers F 13. Highlight of the exhibition. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.
Dornier Libelle II flying boat. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

French-built Ateliers Aeronautiques de Colombes AAC.1 Toucan, the licence version of the Ju 52/3m, fitted with a BMW 132 radial. Walk-through centrepiece of the exhibition. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.
Bf 109 E-3, works number 2804. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

Ex-Swiss Air Force Fieseler Storch A-96. Moved into the Museumsinsel Historische Luftfahrt exhibition; German Wikipedia still lists a Fi 156 C at the Flugwerft Schleissheim. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

Me 262 A-1a, works number 500071, marked 1+3. The first series-built jet fighter. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

Me 163 B rocket interceptor; X-ray computed tomography scanned at the Fraunhofer EZRT in Fuerth for research into its history. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

The 1921 Vampyr, the first true sailplane. Shown in the gliding gallery. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

Primary training glider in the gliding gallery. On show in the Historische Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation 1918-1945) on level 1 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022 after refurbishment.

fs-24 Phoenix, the first aircraft built entirely of glassfibre-reinforced plastic. Highlight of the Moderne Luftfahrt exhibition. On show in the Moderne Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation since 1945) on level 0 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022.

The Do 27 with which series aircraft construction restarted in the Federal Republic in 1956. On show in the Moderne Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation since 1945) on level 0 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022.
Prototype of the carbon-fibre Grob G180 SPn business jet. On show in the Moderne Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation since 1945) on level 0 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022.

Lockheed Starfighter; the museum describes its exhibit as a US-built training machine, which points to an F-104F rather than a licence-built F-104G. Serial left blank: the code 21+53 is quoted for Starfighters at both Munich sites and is recorded here against the Flugwerft Schleissheim aircraft. On show in the Moderne Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation since 1945) on level 0 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022.

Fuselage section of the first Airbus A300, shown with a section of an A350 XWB. On show in the Moderne Luftfahrt exhibition (aviation since 1945) on level 0 of the Munich Museumsinsel aviation hall, reopened 8 July 2022. Fuselage only.
